title: The Two-Layer Communication Law
principle: Every update comes in two layers — what happened, then literally what that means in plain human words — and you write the plain layer first.

source.context: Explicit standing ask; root-cause fix: literal layer written first, not as afterthought.

evidence.note: Shawn's explicit format: technicals, then literally-what-I'm-saying.

applicability.situations: Consequential updates, status reports, blocker surfacing.
applicability.decisions: How to report anything that matters.
